attachments.origin_landmark: ischial tuberosity, inferomedial facet of the upper area (conjoint tendon with biceps femoris long head)
attachments.insertion_landmark: pes anserinus (medial proximal tibia, with sartorius and gracilis)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population, notable for a distinctive tendinous inscription mid-belly

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: dual endplate bands, one on each side of the mid-belly tendinous inscription -- an architectural distinctive feature of this muscle -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Unusually long fascicles (near-full muscle length either side of the inscription) give large excursion for its size.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) (describes the semitendinosus tendinous inscription)

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_from: the medial and lateral femoral condyles
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Distal of two zones on this line, which runs distal to proximal.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part III -- Proximal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(5):240 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17050240 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_from: the medial and lateral femoral condyles
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part III -- Proximal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(5):240 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17050240 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the proximal third of the posterior thigh, medial portion, and again on the distal third -- two sites matching the muscle's two arborization zones.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial to adductor magnus; at the proximal third three masses are seen, with semimembranosus medial and semitendinosus lateral.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Two injection points follow from the zones at 25-40% and 60-80%.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part III -- Proximal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(5):240 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17050240 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites
